slides.title: What is RECON feed
slides.html:
• RECON Feed is automatically created Data Sync feed for Deploy App
  • It is used for reviewed and verified intelligence and observations
  • Basically the current enemy locations are other critical information

slides.title: RECON feed basics
slides.html:
• RECON Feed is meant to be managed by Command Post
  • Fighters have read only access to it
  • Every user in the Deploy App is subscribed to RECON Feed

slides.title: RECON Feed updating information 1
slides.html: • Fighters send observations to Command Post via Observation feed or via GeoChat to HQ role users

slides.title: RECON Feed updating information 2
slides.html:
• Command Post Reviews the received information, verifies it and if needed forwards it to the RECON Feed
  • CP Also keeps track on information on the feed and old, unrelevant information is removed from the feed

slides.title: RECON Feed updating information 3
slides.html:
• Added information will appear for all users
  • Removed information will dissappear from the users.

slides.title: RECON Feed recycling
slides.html:
• Lots of information is placed on the RECON feed during active use and it needs to be recycled to clear out old information
  • Recycling is done by Command Post and Fighters get invited to the new feeds with regular intervals

slides.title: You understand now basics of RECON feed
